name: REPLACE-WITH-DATASET-NAME
notes: This file is a template. It contains no data on purpose: the platform must not ship or invent patient data.
Fill in one entry per case, then run: python scripts/make_splits.py --data <this file>
Every case needs patient_id so the split can be made per patient rather than per slice.
Four-channel models need four co-registered modalities per case; single-channel models need one image.
